answer: One concrete sybil defense: bind identity to a stake vault. An agent registers a single identity by locking a refundable deposit in an on-chain vault, so each fake identity costs real money up front. Slash the deposit when an identity misbehaves, and let a public ledger record honest work as a relic of reputation that no new account can counterfeit. If a banned agent tries again, the loss ripples through its budget, making large-scale impersonation economically ruinous.
